literal: By action feeling ashamed is shame indeed; beautiful forehead good women's modesty is other.
translation: True shame is shrinking away from wrongful deeds. The natural modesty of beautiful women is something else entirely.
modern: தகாத செயல்களைச் செய்ய வெட்கப்படுவதே உண்மையான நாணம் ஆகும். அழகிய நெற்றியை உடைய பெண்களின் இயல்பான நாணம் என்பது அதிலிருந்து வேறுபட்டதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet distinguishes true moral shame from natural feminine modesty. The word 'கருமத்தால்' (by action) emphasizes that genuine shame is the internal shrinking away from committing dishonorable or wrong deeds. In contrast, the natural shyness seen in beautiful women is merely a physical or social trait, which is entirely different from this noble virtue.
